text.p: Summaries of Spanish first division matches played Sunday:
Zaragoza 3 (Gustavo Poyet 11th minute, Gustavo Lopez 37th, 47th) Barcelona 5 (Luis Figo 21st, Ronaldo 54th, 85th, Gheorghe Popescu 73rd, pen, Luis Enrique Martinez 81st). Halftime 2-1. 35,000.
Rayo Vallecano 3 (Dmitry Radchenko 18th, Guilherme 79th, Klimowicz 86th) Celta 0. 1-0. 9,000.
Logrones 2 (David Clotet 7th, Jose Luis Morales 89th) Sevilla 0. 1-0. 15,000.
Oviedo 2 (Petr Dubovsky 64th, pen, Fernando Gamboa 85th) Real Madrid 3 (Davor Suker 13th, Predrag Mijatovic 15th, Carlos Secretario 44th). 0-3. 21,000.
